scope: Reviewed source ownership and required operation boundaries; source mapping does not certify live callback reachability or browser delivery.

groups.work: Captured image/tool request or job-scoped Stop; GPU work is deferred to the serial native worker.
groups.resource_owner: app/async_worker.py JobRegistry + resource_lifecycle.py compute:shared and model/artifact leases
groups.persistence: Worker owns completed output and metadata publication; UI inputs are captured before native admission.
groups.cancellation: Authenticated bound task ID; cooperative native interrupt and owner cleanup. Stop stays queue-free.
groups.acceptance: Lifecycle CPU callers verified; live GPU lifecycle and browser delivery remain separate acceptance.

groups.work: Local custom resolution, model-default or profile mutation.
groups.resource_owner: resolution_settings.py, performance_settings.py and core/settings.py owning profile/resource
groups.persistence: Owning configuration transaction and config_io.save_json atomic replace; no native model mutation.
groups.cancellation: Short mutation completes atomically; later explicit save wins. No rollback of another caller's committed profile.
groups.acceptance: Profile/default CPU suites cover transaction callers; simultaneous browser profile saves require acceptance.

groups.work: Navigation, localization dispatch, captured upload/metadata/preset, model/size/default projection and preview timers.
groups.resource_owner: Per-browser Gradio controls/draft; shared model catalogue read snapshots owned by features/models
groups.persistence: Local control updates only except explicit feature-owned actions; original image paths and metadata remain authoritative.
groups.cancellation: Short reads must not await compute; delayed model projections need latest selection fencing. Localization helpers expand at app composition.
groups.acceptance: Source mapped; model/default delayed-result and all-control loading rows require browser acceptance; no GPU permission.

groups.work: Captured Chat load/unload/reply and optional image-tool handoff.
groups.resource_owner: Request-owned JobRegistry, ChatModelSession and serialized compute:shared admission
groups.persistence: Session conversation/draft; completed image output only through worker. Model transfer completion never selects another model.
groups.cancellation: Bound reply/download handles and attachment-turn cancellation; native cleanup remains request-owned.
groups.acceptance: Chat/lifecycle CPU contracts exist; real Chat-to-image-to-Chat and browser delivery are separate root acceptance.

groups.work: Captured model acquisition, local import/remove or folder selection; independent of native compute.
groups.resource_owner: ChatModelSession subscriptions, PreparationService destination single-flight and artifact read/write leases
groups.persistence: Verified no-clobber artifact promotion; imported/removal paths validated by their native owner.
groups.cancellation: Subscriber cancellation never cancels another subscriber; selection revision rejects stale activation.
groups.acceptance: Preparation queue and Chat callers verified on CPU; browser download A/use installed B remains explicit acceptance.

groups.work: Explicit assistant profile save, startup selection and confirmed deletion.
groups.resource_owner: features/chat/assistants.py profile revision/transaction and per-browser editor draft
groups.persistence: Atomic versioned assistant save/delete; stale edit detection belongs to the assistant repository.
groups.cancellation: Editor Cancel discards only that draft; started atomic save is a short operation.
groups.acceptance: Assistant transaction CPU suites exist; simultaneous editor browser acceptance pending.

groups.work: Explicit bounded installed-runtime metadata inspection, respecting global CPU authority; independent of native model execution.
groups.resource_owner: Per-browser RuntimeInfoSession token, two-slot chat-runtime-inspection callback lane, bounded PreparationAdmission and owned bounded_subprocess child/job cleanup
groups.persistence: Read-only installed version/device report; prior successful display remains on cancellation/failure. No profile, model or runtime installation mutation.
groups.cancellation: Queue-free Cancel targets the queued Gradio refresh event and signals a running session child; subprocess deadlines/output caps and owned process-tree cleanup remain authoritative.
groups.acceptance: Runtime owner supplies CPU child/caller/queued-cancel proofs; W05 performs no runtime/device probe or model execution.

groups.work: Model search/selection, reasoning/vision/context display, assistant draft, attachment capture/clear and bounded RAG settings.
groups.resource_owner: Per-session model/conversation/attachment identity; RAG manifest/index and embedding preparation owners
groups.persistence: Only explicit RAG/profile save writes; attachment corpus retained per owned request/session and cleaned by that owner.
groups.cancellation: Selected model/request revisions and attachment turn events reject changed sources. CPU parser/runtime subprocess deadlines owned by Chat.
groups.acceptance: Source groups mapped; extraction limits, delayed search, two-session and live delivery tracked by Chat acceptance.

groups.work: Browse/search/page, incremental refresh/cancel, metadata selection and source-preserving handoffs.
groups.resource_owner: LatestUIRequests authenticated view/selection channels; two-worker/eight-slot preparation; SQLite per-database writer
groups.persistence: WAL previous complete snapshot; changed-file parse and atomic fenced commit. Original images are retained.
groups.cancellation: Queue-free acknowledgement; cooperative per-file cancellation; _view_version/_selection_version checked by source actions.
groups.acceptance: Real SQLite and installed Gradio callback races verified on CPU; transport paint timing requires browser evidence.

groups.work: Library source adoption into Create and source-preserving editing draft capture.
groups.resource_owner: Versioned selected source and ordinary Create typed request/draft builders
groups.persistence: Only session control changes until the explicit worker action; source identity/dimensions/alpha remain immutable inputs.
groups.cancellation: Reject changed selection/view before source activation; generation Stop uses its owning job.
groups.acceptance: Library action and draft CPU checks exist; direct edit browser delivery and final generation remain separate.

groups.work: Open an authenticated current source or completed Chat/Gallery result, or move through owned image history; no implicit generation.
groups.resource_owner: EditorWorkspace LatestUIRequests channel, EditorSessionStore authenticated owner/revision and PreparationService artifact read leases; Gallery draft publication also uses its prompt fence
groups.persistence: New source adoption copies bounded original pixels/files into owned editor artifacts and atomically records the session manifest; undo/redo/reopen changes only that owned history. Library prompt/setup publication preserves a newer edited draft.
groups.cancellation: Source/history intent signals only the bound task, versions its channel and rejects superseded publication. Staged failed inputs unwind their own copies; missing/changed source or stale history requires reopening the current owned artifact.
groups.acceptance: Registered source sites and installed-Gradio Editor/Chat/Gallery CPU callers are covered separately from rendered browser delivery, real-model output and device qualification. Loop bindings are source sites, not a runtime action count.

groups.work: Bind an explicitly uploaded exact-frame selection mask to the current owned image revision.
groups.resource_owner: EditorSessionStore authenticated session/source/revision and bounded EditorWorkspace staged input capture with PreparationService artifact lease
groups.persistence: Copy the uploaded mask into an owned artifact and atomically bind its source/frame identity; original upload and source image remain intact. Failed staging deletes only its own new input copy.
groups.cancellation: A stale, absent or replaced source fails before mask binding. Changing image intent invalidates pending worker publication; the mask itself does not start native compute or cancel another session.
groups.acceptance: Exact-frame and owned-source CPU contracts cover mask adoption and later worker handoff; rendered brush/upload delivery and generated visual results remain separate.

groups.work: Capture the selected image action and report its current local source/model/component readiness without enqueueing native compute or acquiring missing models.
groups.resource_owner: Authenticated EditorSessionStore request ticket and image_preparation capture/readiness owners; short file reads use their normal source/component contracts
groups.persistence: Request capture may stage an explicitly selected background or painted mask as an owned artifact. The finally path cancels the temporary request ticket; no generated result is adopted into image history.
groups.cancellation: Temporary editor request is cancelled in finally on both success and failure. Missing/changed image, mask or components require a new explicit selection; readiness does not control another worker or subscription.
groups.acceptance: Source-bound readiness/capture CPU checks do not certify downloads, native execution, visual quality or browser paint.

groups.work: Explicitly attach a completed proven grayscale mask result to its retained original image and switch to inpainting.
groups.resource_owner: LatestUIRequests authenticated Editor channel and EditorSessionStore owner/revision/result/source-frame validation
groups.persistence: Lossless RGB8-to-L8 mask extraction and original-source restoration publish in one owned manifest transaction; original RGB, alpha, metadata and mask-result history remain intact. Precision masks/sources require an explicit working copy.
groups.cancellation: A pending operation, stale revision, foreign owner, changed artifact, wrong frame or unproven result is rejected before source restoration. Only the bound task is signalled by the shared source-action fence.
groups.acceptance: Actual Gradio event, source preservation and stale/foreign/wrong-frame CPU cases verified; browser delivery and model generation remain separate acceptance.

groups.work: Project owned map provenance, or explicitly restore its original image and attach a separate editing guide; Face selection maps reuse the existing mask/inpaint handoff.
groups.resource_owner: EditorWorkspace LatestUIRequests authenticated channel, EditorSessionStore owner/revision/artifact contracts and guide_handoffs frozen source/guide capture; guide_control_compat owns finite installed-consumer verification
groups.persistence: Explicit attachment atomically restores only the owned original/history pointer. Guide identities and denoise are transient server/UI state; prompts, dimensions, manual strengths and startup defaults are preserved. Rendering performs no model verification, download or native execution.
groups.cancellation: Control-file preflight occurs outside the shared UI publication lock. Changed source, owner or intent rejects late attachment/projection; another Editor action clears the guide's extra-image role. Failure requires an explicit compatible local control selection or reopening the current source.
groups.acceptance: Installed-Gradio callback/build-capture tests cover distinct original/guide pixels, Face reuse, draft preservation and source/intent races. Native compatibility, finished-image quality, GPU and browser delivery remain separately qualified.

groups.work: Project action-specific inputs and Run label, open More tools for explicit Adjust image intent, reset stale source context and advance the browser-owned Editor intent version.
groups.resource_owner: Per-browser Editor controls and LatestUIRequests authenticated workspace channel; optional cancellation targets only its bound task ID
groups.persistence: Control/version updates only; no editor artifact, profile or generated image is published by these callbacks. The tool selector sets explicit Adjust image intent for that alias and Generate intent for other tools.
groups.cancellation: Queue-free intent invalidation fences delayed terminal adoption and signals only the bound task. A changed upload/selection clears its stale context so the current owned image must be opened again.
groups.acceptance: Installed-Gradio CPU journeys cover local action/context invalidation. Source support is distinct from browser transport timing and real-model acceptance.

groups.work: Catalogue/filter/page/artwork, details/role projections, explicit captured download/cancel and installed-file activation.
groups.resource_owner: Versioned Catalogue cache publication; authenticated LatestUIRequests view/selection/details/role/context/page channels; bounded PreparationAdmission, AcquisitionSession, PreparationService and preview artifact owners
groups.persistence: Only captured downloads promote verified no-clobber files; source receipt/cache updates are atomic. Browse does not load models.
groups.cancellation: Queue-free acknowledgements; superseded waiting preparation futures cancel immediately, scans check cancellation per entry/path, late success/error and source actions validate current view/selection. Transfers retain subscriber cancellation.
groups.acceptance: Deterministic actual callback/Gradio and cache races verified on CPU; ordinary widget transport paint and actual full-app A/B journeys remain browser acceptance.

groups.work: Local checkpoint/LoRA/embedding search, details, component roles, source defaults and override/reset projections.
groups.resource_owner: Shared read-only catalogue snapshots; per-owner checkpoint query/card/identity/description fences through bounded preparation; explicit component/default settings owner
groups.persistence: Explicit inspect/default/override operations use model cache/config transactions; ordinary selection changes only browser draft.
groups.cancellation: Source signatures validated at action boundaries; delayed local filtering and detail results need latest-selection fencing.
groups.acceptance: Source mapped; targeted model CPU suites exist; callback-by-callback two-session delivery remains browser acceptance.

groups.work: Precision output choices and explicit source-preserving still-image import/export; separate from model generation.
groups.resource_owner: Validated selected source record, bounded native_image_formats codec/copy owner and one-slot native-image-exports Gradio lane
groups.persistence: Imports copy admitted original bytes to a new path; exports write unique derived cache files. Temporary files publish atomically without clobbering original files.
groups.cancellation: No explicit codec Cancel is exposed; an admitted bounded file operation runs to completion or unwinds its own temporary file. It does not cancel native generation or mutate shared model state.
groups.acceptance: Precision/source/native-format owner proofs remain separate; W05 has not imported/exported existing user images or executed codecs.

groups.work: Local image operation/format, mask/reference, typed native controls and utilities request composition.
groups.resource_owner: Per-session controls and source-signature draft; explicit execution dispatches to JobRegistry/native admission
groups.persistence: No generated output until admitted worker; uploaded source/metadata kept distinct from preview and typed control values.
groups.cancellation: Control reads remain independent; computation uses owning task Stop and model/artifact leases.
groups.acceptance: Each native owner supplies CPU source/caller coverage; source support is not real-model acceptance. Video execution excluded.

groups.work: Prompt drafts/styles/previews/randomization and explicit rewrite/evolve helper requests.
groups.resource_owner: Session draft version fence; dataset cache owner; helper compute through owned prompt preparation and compute admission
groups.persistence: Explicit style/preset save uses its configuration owner; computed result cannot overwrite an edited prompt draft.
groups.cancellation: UI draft tokens fence helper publication; explicit helper cancellation/compute owner remains authoritative.
groups.acceptance: Prompt draft/preparation CPU contracts exist; live tool delivery and draft preservation tracked separately.

groups.work: Bounded cache-size scan or explicit allowlisted derived-cache deletion.
groups.resource_owner: PreparationAdmission cache_maintenance lane and inactive artifact write lease per cache entry
groups.persistence: Only allowlisted derived entries; skip active readers/pending artifacts and retain source/runtime/user inputs.
groups.cancellation: No broad cleanup; short bounded operations report removed/skipped/errors. Serial resource mutation lane.
groups.acceptance: Cache ownership CPU contracts verified; maintenance browser delivery remains separate.

groups.work: Read-only support/package plan, explicit runtime/backend install/update/rollback/verify and cancellation.
groups.resource_owner: Frozen package plan, runtime action session, process/install lock and private per-runtime bundle
groups.persistence: Install transaction verifies bundle before active pointer switch; profile requested state remains distinct from loaded native state.
groups.cancellation: Session-owned cancellable subprocess/install transaction; queue-free Cancel. No concurrent native model mutation inferred.
groups.acceptance: Source ownership mapped; no installs/probes/GPU allowed in W05. Actual install/cancel/recovery acceptance belongs to runtime owner.

groups.work: Private queue-free refresh/tab projection of bounded redacted API workload facts.
groups.resource_owner: app/api_activity.py ApiActivity short RLock snapshot; at most 128 memory-only records for one hour, displaying at most 20 rows
groups.persistence: No disk or profile writes; only workload/state/duration facts. Request contents, paths, credentials, result contents and error messages are not accepted by the activity recorder.
groups.cancellation: Short read-only snapshot has no worker or install to cancel; it cannot cancel or change the observed jobs. Both UI bindings hide progress and bypass the Gradio queue.
groups.acceptance: Chat owner supplies activity/privacy CPU proofs; source ownership is distinct from actual rendered activity delivery.

groups.work: Language/theme/text layout, profile save/save-as/next-launch, local paths, guest/API workspace and explicit reinstall intent.
groups.resource_owner: core/settings.py and path manager transaction; server-authenticated owner/guest checks; bounded Chat runtime refresh owner
groups.persistence: Configuration atomic replace and profile revision checks; paths captured for pending jobs. Profile save does not mutate active native models.
groups.cancellation: Short local changes; active acquisition/install uses owning session. Successful logout invalidates job and UI channels for its login prefix.
groups.acceptance: Profile/path/guest CPU suites exist; live concurrent save/navigation/runtime-refresh delivery remains owner acceptance.

groups.work: Legacy Gradio RPC Chat/image calls capture configured defaults and wait synchronously for the admitted serial worker.
groups.resource_owner: api_runtime bounded Job, captured request owner, JobRegistry and compute:shared native admission
groups.persistence: Worker owns completed output and metadata; RPC waits for its own terminal result.
groups.cancellation: Synchronous wait is bounded to 1800 seconds and finally signals only its job. These legacy handlers expose no explicit Stop; cancelling a running Gradio Python thread is not an immediate native interrupt guarantee.
groups.acceptance: Source-bound compatibility endpoints only; no legacy compute RPC, model or GPU execution was performed by this audit.

groups.work: Legacy Gradio RPC local image search, version and last-image path reads.
groups.resource_owner: Configured output search owner and read-only application version/last-image state; normal Gradio/UI access boundary
groups.persistence: No model or profile mutation and no generated output; search returns existing image URLs.
groups.cancellation: No native worker or explicit Stop for these synchronous reads; each call returns only its own search/state result.
groups.acceptance: Source-bound registration and callback identity verified; live endpoint reachability remains separate.

groups.work: Authenticated UI last-image display or opaque expiring API-generated-file capability delivery.
groups.resource_owner: UI login gate and display-copy owner, or API assets token map restricted to generated paths and 24-hour expiry
groups.persistence: Read/stream existing output or derived display bytes; API capability never accepts an arbitrary client filesystem path.
groups.cancellation: HTTP response lifespan; no generation, model load, install or cross-owner job cancellation.
groups.acceptance: Imperative route/source identity verified; HTTP media transfer and browser display are separate acceptance.

groups.work: Authenticated API model/capability and current-request default snapshots.
groups.resource_owner: Web access/API token owner; local catalogue and api_runtime image_defaults snapshot
groups.persistence: Read-only route; no model load/acquisition.
groups.cancellation: HTTP request lifespan; no long worker or mutation to cancel.
groups.acceptance: API contract CPU callers verified; network service receipt is distinct from browser delivery.

groups.work: Authenticated Chat/image/edit/upscale/histogram/review request and explicitly excluded video route. Model-free histogram work still uses the admitted serial worker in the current source.
groups.resource_owner: api_runtime eight-slot admission, per-request owner + JobRegistry and serialized compute:shared
groups.persistence: Worker owns completed files/metadata; captured request cannot be rewritten by another browser's controls.
groups.cancellation: Disconnect/cancel signals owning JobRegistry task; terminal/capacity release once; no cancellation of another owner.
groups.acceptance: API/lifecycle CPU caller contracts exist; real-model/platform and HTTP streaming cancellation remain separate bounded acceptance.
